_note: Online lobby layout, in 1920x1080 pixels. Colours are [r, g, b] or [r, g, b, a] from 0 to 255; opacities given as 0 to 255 say so, the others are 0 to 1, like the scales. Offsets named *_dx / *_dy / *_y_offset are from their panel's or row's left, top or centre; insets are taken off a width.

difficulty_colors._note: Each difficulty's text colour (Easy to Extra): its emblem's hue, darkened for the light panels.

emblem._note: A level's digits: each next digit starts digit_advance of the previous digit's width further; a plus level's + sits off the last digit's top-right corner by (plus_dx, plus_dy), times the emblem's scale.

toast._note: The message bar: one line at font_size when it fits max_width, else wrapped at wrap_font_size. It keeps its bottom edge at bottom and grows upwards: pad_height + line_height per line, at least min_height. opacity is 0 to 255.

code._note: The room-code entry. The field shows at most max_chars characters (the end of a longer code, after an ellipsis).

jacket._note: The jacket's top left and size, inside a border; missing_inset is taken off the width of the song-not-found text.

song_info._note: Under the jacket, centred on center_x. The five emblems start at emblems.x, step apart; a difficulty the chart lacks shows the empty emblem at missing_opacity.

speed_buttons._note: The host's song speed buttons, placed from song_info.center_x.

rows._note: One row per seat: the first at (x, top), one every pitch. The player's own row has a marker_width strip. A host's status sits host_status_dy over the row's centre, the host tag host_tag_dy under it.

deck._note: The bottom panel: the menu on the left of split, the chosen tab's content right of it. The divider is divider_width wide, divider_inset off the panel's top and bottom.

difficulty_row._note: The deck's difficulty tab: five emblems from x_offset right of the split, step apart; the chosen one at full size on a marker, the others at other_scale / other_opacity, the ones the song lacks at missing_scale / missing_opacity. The difficulty's name sits name_gap right of the last emblem, right_inset off the panel's right edge.

connecting._note: The cover while a join connects; overlay_opacity is 0 to 255.

results._note: Rows from top, one every pitch, inset off the panel's sides; the next button sits button_gap under the panel.
